adminGuide.title: Site operations guide
adminGuide.intro: Common settings and workflows that guild operators often miss. Each section links directly to where you can edit it.

eventLifecycle.title: Event lifecycle
eventLifecycle.step1: Create event: fill in time/location/notes. Saved as draft initially.
eventLifecycle.step2: Configure parties/slots: load a template or add parties → set role, gear, and spec per slot.
eventLifecycle.step3: Publish: use the banner button to move the event to a state where members can apply.
eventLifecycle.step4: Mark battle started: press the 'Battle Started' button to lock battle_started_at. Regear window timer begins from this moment.
eventLifecycle.step5: After the event: the auto-regear cron reads killboard and generates approvals. Members can submit manual regear once the window opens.

regear.title: Regear system
regear.body: Auto (killboard-based) and manual (screenshot-based) regear coexist. Per-role cap (role_rewards.silver) of 0 blocks all regear for that role.
regear.bullet1: The auto-regear toggle is a global switch. It must be ON for the cron to convert killboard deaths into approvals.
regear.bullet2: Slot editor has 'Exclude from auto-regear' (visible only when global ON) and 'Exclude from manual regear' (always) checkboxes for per-build opt-out.
regear.bullet3: Regear window = N minutes after battle start. Max screenshot 10MB, PNG/JPEG/WebP only.
regear.bullet4: Auto-generated pending rows let the claimant edit per-slot prices. Admins review at /admin/dashboard/regear.

onboarding.title: Albion nickname verification
onboarding.body:
New members see an Albion server/nickname onboarding modal after login. On successful verification, both the site and Discord guild nicknames sync to the Albion name.

Verification requires an 'Albion home guild ID' set in Settings → Events tab. Without it, identities are stored but left unverified (verifiedAt=null).

The Stats page shows unverified/pending members. The 'Re-onboard' button clears a member's albion_* fields so the modal shows again.

bombSquad.title: Bomb-squad party & caller
bombSquad.body:
Bomb-squad parties use a 'members apply freely → caller approves/direct-assigns' flow. To use it:

1) Go to Settings → Permissions and configure at least one caller role.
2) Have at least one guild member with that role.
3) In the event party editor, toggle 'Bomb Squad' on and pick a caller.

Callers get a dedicated edit page at /events/{id}/party/{n} where they manage their own party's slots and members.

shop.title: Guild shop
shop.body:
Members exchange points for gear. Stock syncs via manual 'log paste' (ShopImportForm).

Silver↔point exchange rate (discount_rate) is a discount on a 1:1 base. 100% means silver price = point price; 50% sells for half.

AODP price warnings (quality/window/bluezone/redzone) surface when auto-regear suspects a problematic row.

notifications.title: Discord notifications
notifications.body:
Two delivery channels: event channel announcements and personal DMs.

- Event channel: configured via notify_channel_id + notify_role_id (role mention). Sent via a manual button on event create/edit.
- Personal DM: auto-sent 35 min before event to assigned members. Users can opt out in /me/settings.
- Regear/exchange approvals also DM the requester.

Requires DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN, DISCORD_EVENT_CHANNEL_ID, DISCORD_GUILD_ID env vars.

stats.title: Stats & monitoring
stats.body: Top/bottom point holders, event participation, shop/regear activity, and Albion verification status in one page. Use the inline 'Re-onboard' button to restart the onboarding flow for unverified members.

tips.title: Operation tips
tips.tip1: Before big changes, review global toggles (auto-regear, auto-start) in Settings.
tips.tip2: Save slot layouts as templates at /admin/dashboard/templates. Load quickly from the event editor.
tips.tip3: Use the party editor's 'Hide party' button to hide in-progress parties from the public page.
tips.tip4: For data issues, query Supabase Dashboard SQL editor directly. The 3 core tables: guild_avatars, regear_requests, point_ledger.

adminAutoRegear.title: Auto regear
adminAutoRegear.descriptionLine1: After an event ends, the cron pulls death records from the killboard, prices them with AODP, and creates pending regear rows. No points are paid until an admin approves each row.
adminAutoRegear.descriptionLine2: Uses the existing regear payout rate and AODP settings. Members not assigned to a party are skipped. The per-build exclude checkbox only appears in the slot editor while this option is on.
adminAutoRegear.toggleHint: When off, only the existing manual request flow runs.
adminAutoRegear.delayHint: The cron processes the event this many minutes after battle start. Too short and the killboard sync may not catch up, causing victims to be missed. Default 15 minutes, range {min}–{max}.
adminAutoRegear.delayInvalid: Delay must be an integer between {min} and {max} minutes.

adminAllowUnverified.title: Allow unverified members to access the site
adminAllowUnverified.description: When off, members who haven't completed Albion verification are redirected to the onboarding page on site entry and can't use any other page until verified. Admins, guest invite links, and public paths are always exempt.
adminAllowUnverified.toggleLabel: Let unverified members use the site
adminAllowUnverified.toggleHint: When off, site access is blocked until onboarding is complete.

adminCdBadge.title: CD badge role filter
adminCdBadge.descriptionLine1: Pick which roles show the weapon skill cooldown badge (including leather armor / food reductions).
adminCdBadge.descriptionLine2: Defaults to DPS only — check other roles if needed. If nothing is selected, no slot shows the badge.

adminRegearVerify.title: Require Albion verification for regear
adminRegearVerify.descriptionLine1: When on, members who haven't verified their Albion name can't submit regear requests; they see a button linking to the profile verification page instead.
adminRegearVerify.descriptionLine2: When off, unverified members can still submit regear requests (use this to revert to the old default).
adminRegearVerify.toggleHint: Blocks regear submissions from unverified users.

adminShopSilverRate.title: Shop discount rate
adminShopSilverRate.description: Multiplier applied to both manual and automatic (AODP silver) prices. Points and silver are 1:1, so final points = silver × discount rate. Range (0, 1]. 1 means no discount, 0.5 means 50% off.

adminAodp.title: AODP price settings
adminAodp.description: Shared price-lookup options used by shop auto-pricing and auto regear.
adminAodp.cityHint: Choose one city to use as your guild's home market. If a price isn't available there, the lookup falls back to other royal cities and then to the red zone.
adminAodp.modeAvg14dHint: Long-term average · cushions sudden price swings
adminAodp.qualityHint: If a dropped item's quality is below this value, the lookup uses this quality instead. Default 1 (no adjustment).

adminAlbionHomeGuild.title: Home guild · Albion server
adminAlbionHomeGuild.description: Sets the server and "our guild" used for Albion onboarding and killboard auto-verification. Guild UUIDs differ per server, so the two values are always saved as a pair. If the home guild is empty, all onboardings are saved as [unverified].
adminAlbionHomeGuild.unsetWarning: Unset — saving now will mark all onboardings as [unverified]

adminRegearLimits.title: Regear submission limits
adminRegearLimits.description: Set how long members must wait before regear requests open, and how many requests one person can file per event. New values apply to requests filed from now on.
adminRegearLimits.windowMinutesHint: {min}–{max} minutes. Members can file regear requests this many minutes after battle starts. The delay exists because Albion's killboard needs time to process death records.
adminRegearLimits.maxDeathsHint: {min}–{max}. The maximum number of requests one member can file for the same event. Rejected requests don't count, so they can retry.

adminEventAutoStart.title: Auto-start events
adminEventAutoStart.description: The site automatically marks an event as 'Battle Started' once its gather time has passed. Regear requests then open at the scheduled time without an admin having to press Start.
adminEventAutoStart.enabledHint: When enabled, the site checks every 5 minutes and auto-starts any event whose gather time has passed. Only events within the last 30 minutes are processed to avoid bulk-starting old events.

adminRegearPayoutRate.title: Regear payout rate
adminRegearPayoutRate.description: Set the percentage of the claimed amount that is paid out in silver when a regear request is approved. The default is 100%. Changes apply to approvals from now on.
adminRegearPayoutRate.percentHint: {min}–{max}%. For example, at 80%, approving a 10,000-silver claim pays out 8,000 silver.

publicLanding.tagline: Run your Albion Online guild from one place.
publicLanding.subheading: Event scheduling, automatic regear payouts, a guild shop, and member analytics — install one Discord bot and let it handle the busywork.
publicLanding.ctaPrimary: Install the bot on my Discord
publicLanding.feature1Body: Compose party/slot builds, publish, and the channel gets an @everyone notification automatically. Members sign up for slots from the web and check in.
publicLanding.feature2Body: Killboard plus AODP market data feed an auto-payout flow that compensates fallen members after each fight. Manual claims and admin approval workflows are built in.
publicLanding.feature3Body: Sell in-game items for points at automatically-priced rates. Baseline check-in/out tracking and drift reports keep stock honest.
publicLanding.feature4Body: Killboard polling captures guild battles. Per-member K/D, weapon usage, and attendance roll up automatically.
publicLanding.howStep1: Sign in with Discord and pick the guild that should host the bot.
publicLanding.howStep2: Wire up member/admin roles, an announcement channel, and your Albion guild ID.
publicLanding.howStep3: You're live at <slug>your-guild.albion-guildmanager.com</slug> and ready to run events.
publicLanding.footerNote: Made by Monkku · Guild operations automation

shop.aodpTooltip: AODP (Albion Online Data Project) is a crowd-sourced API where players share market prices captured from the game client. Data density varies by server, city, and time, so when recent prices for the configured base city are unavailable, the system falls back through lower quality → 14-day average → other royal cities → red-zone cities. When that fallback chain runs, the estimate may diverge from real trade value, and a "Price estimate" warning is shown.

priceWarningBuyer.quality: Price estimate: no market data for this item quality, so we substituted a lower-quality price.
priceWarningBuyer.window: Price estimate: recent market data is sparse, averaged over up to 14 days.
priceWarningBuyer.bluezone: Price estimate: no price data for the current city, so we used another Royal City's price. Actual trades may incur teleport cost and travel time.
priceWarningBuyer.redzone: Price estimate: no Royal City data at all — we used Red Zone prices (Caerleon / Brecilien). Actual value may differ significantly due to PvP risk.

priceWarningAdmin.quality: Price estimate: no data for the requested quality, so we substituted a lower-quality price.
priceWarningAdmin.window: Price estimate: recent market data is sparse, averaged over up to 14 days.
priceWarningAdmin.bluezone: Price estimate: no data for the configured city, so we used another Royal City's price.
priceWarningAdmin.redzone: Price estimate: no Royal City data at all — using Red Zone prices. Actual value may differ significantly; admin review recommended.
